scope: Eight static portable-item identities. No new gameplay, spawns, animation or runtime integration claim.

frames.description: One detached squat orange root with short cut sage leaves and a tapered edible end.
frames.realSource: The public CandyCarrotCrop automatically releases two real food owners on completion.
frames.actualUse: Consume a carried unit for1d4 healing through FoodPart.
frames.limits: Food.Cooking=Meal is flavor, not a Cookable part. No prepared meal, planted crown, soil or new growth state.

frames.description: One small pale oblique seed with a dry crease; no sack or planted mound.
frames.realSource: Starting supplies and finite SeedKeeperStock; not a saved-seed yield of this automatic crop.
frames.actualUse: Consume a carried seed to plant CandyCarrotCrop on eligible Plantable ground, or an adjacent prepared bed.
frames.limits: A loose seed is not already planted and does not promise water, growth time or multiple units.

frames.description: One long narrow golden grain with a quiet dry seam.
frames.realSource: Starting supplies and finite SeedKeeperStock; distinct from the harvested Emberwheat sheaf.
frames.actualUse: Consume a carried seed to plant EmberwheatCrop on eligible ground.
frames.limits: Warm lore does not grant LightSource or combustion. No flame, glow, cut stalk or seed packet.

frames.description: Detached knuckled red-clay clod with short pale root strands wrapped around it.
frames.realSource: Actual mature MarlrootCrop yields two clods and one separate saved seed.
frames.actualUse: BotanicalProcessing Prepare consumes one carried clod and creates one FireClay.
frames.limits: Unprepared clod, not already refined repair clay, edible root, stone ore, leafy crop or decorative extra yield.

frames.description: One squat angular red-brown seed with a pale nick and dark dry lower edge.
frames.realSource: One saved seed accompanies real mature Marlroot harvest.
frames.actualUse: Consume a carried seed to plant MarlrootCrop in actual cultivated soil.
frames.limits: No root strands, soil clod, resin, prepared clay or already claimed bed.

frames.description: One irregular low amber solid with a restrained matte cut face and thick dark edge.
frames.realSource: Actual mature PitchpodCrop yields two resin units and one separate saved seed.
frames.actualUse: Raw Reagent heat:1,combustible:1, usable in existing brewing.
frames.limits: Not a finished bottle, burning coating, glowing jewel, detached paper pod or planted crop.

frames.description: One tapered dry olive seed with a warm amber seam, smaller and darker than the resin.
frames.realSource: One saved seed accompanies real mature Pitchpod harvest.
frames.actualUse: Consume a carried seed to plant PitchpodCrop in actual cultivated soil.
frames.limits: No growing stem, pod shell, flower, flame, resin supply or seed packet.

frames.description: A single low irregular grey-olive compost lump with one muted dry fold; no separate chips.
frames.realSource: Finite keeper/provisioner stock and an actual fallback BrewingService output.
frames.actualUse: Consume one carried unit to compost a freshly planted crop once, reducing growth-stage time25 percent without water.
frames.limits: Neutral stable material, not a container, spilled liquid, water source, sprouting plant or ready potion.
